## Problem or opportunity

What is currently difficult to understand, navigate, or maintain?

## Suggested improvement

Describe your proposed documentation, accessibility, or promotional-specification improvement.

## Documents affected

List the relevant README, docs files, or assets.

## Expected benefit

Who would benefit, and how?

## Alternatives considered

Are there other ways to address the problem?

## Sources and permissions

Link public authoritative evidence for any product, policy, brand, pricing, or technical claims. Confirm that you have rights to propose any assets or text you include.

## Checklist

- [ ] I checked for a similar existing issue or discussion.
- [ ] I understand this repository has a **proprietary license**; public visibility is not permission to reuse or redistribute its materials.
- [ ] I am not requesting access to private storefront source code or customer/order information.
- [ ] This is not a security report or a private customer support request.
